Pree, the ticket is **#8841**. I posted the answer as a reply to your message in #central-random.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he flagged it to support on ticket #8841.
- **What I'm not sure of:** Tobias said it was on his dealer account but didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. A team digest says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on Jan 5, 2026, but it doesn't say who took it over. My reply in the channel said the account moved to Tobias. I had nothing to back that up, so it's an inference, not a fact. It's worth a quick check with Tobias before the customer call.

I only looked at channels and public files you have access to. I didn't need any approvals.
